buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. The purchaser also reserves the right to increase the ordered quantity up to 25% of the contracted quantity during the currency of the contract at the contracted rates. The delivery period of quantity shall commence from the last date of original delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC

Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERMS AND CONDITIONS � Participating bidders must have a registered office located within the state of Kerala and hold an active Goods and Services Tax (GST) number issued by the Indian government. A valid local office license under Kerala state regulations is also mandatory. Relevant supporting documents must be provided for verification purposes. � The bidder must hold GST registration in the same state as the consignee, which is also the jurisdiction of the bid-inviting authority. The GST certificate should reflect the name of the bidding entity. Bidders are req uired to provide proof of having monthlyregular GST returns for the past three years. � Only Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) or their authorized representatives are eligible to particip ate. If submitting the bid as an authorized dealer, a Manufacturer Authorization Certificate specifically referring to this tender must be submitted. � The OEM/Bidder should have a service centre in Consignee District. The service centre address should b e provided � All quoted products must be current models that are still in production and supported by the manufactur er. Bidders must confirm that no quoted items are classified as end-of-life and that manufacturer support is ongoing. � The OEM must maintain a functional service facility within the district where the consignee is located. Th e facility must be equipped to provide prompt maintenance and repair services. Complete details of the se rvice facility must be included with the bid. Service support must be provided within 48 hours. � Bidders should have been actively engaged on the Government e-Marketplace (GeM) portal for at least t he past three years. Appropriate documents verifying this period of activity must be attached. � The bidder must acknowledge and accept the Additional Terms and Conditions (ATCs) of this procuremen t process. A signed letter on company letterhead, indicating compliance with the ATCs as defined by the b uyer, must be submitted. � A declaration must be provided on the bidder’s letterhead stating that the company has not been blacklisted or debarred from government or public procurement in the last five years. � Products offered must strictly conform to the technical specifications mentioned in the tender. Any varia nce from the required specifications will lead to disqualification during technical scrutiny. � The purchaser holds the authority to accept or reject any bids based on a comparative market analysis o f the offered products.

� The brands quoted must enjoy a good reputation, strong industry presence, and be recognized for perfor mance, reliability, and quality. Preference will be given to brands with positive customer experiences and a substantial footprint in the market. � Bidders must show a proven history of supplying Inverter systems the quoted OEM to central/state gover nment departments or PSUs in Kerala over the past three years via the GeM portal. � The bidder must establish a service mechanism within Kerala capable of addressing issues with the prod ucts within 24 hours of a reported breakdown. � An Escalation Matrix including contact phone numbers for service support must be submitted by the bid der or OEM. � If there is any deviation from technical or general requirements specified in the tender, bidders must dis close this explicitly in a technical deviation statement, which should accompany the bid submission. � The bidder must have completed at least three individual work orders of similar products, each worth ₹1 lakhs or more, from the quoted OEM/brand through the GeM portal. These must have been executed withi n Kerala. � Bidders must present a live product demonstration to the consignee on the scheduled date and at the lo cation designated by the consignee. Failure to demonstrate as per schedule will lead to automatic disquali fication. � Drivers and product should be in the public domain � OEM should have minimum at least 3 authorized service center in Kerala state. The address and the cont act details of the same should be provided in the bid. � If any clarification is required regarding the product specifications or quality, the seller/bidder must be pr epared to demonstrate the product if necessary. .
